propositions: Gate snapshot store copies entire ~620 MiB ticket tree on every attested resolution with zero cache key reuse, generating ~10^5x write amplification when tickets tip advances every ~26 seconds

Adjacent ticket SHAs differing by single files each create full separate materialized copies with distinct inodes rather than hardlinked or delta-materialized entries, violating ADR 0005's immutable-SHA cache key reuse assumption
Delta materialization via git read-tree and checkout-index now hardlinks unchanged paths from prior entries and rewrites only changed files, eliminating full-copy behavior

Shared inode accounting requires separate size metrics: entry_size for reporting, exclusive_size for increment accounting (bytes with nlink==1), and distinct_bytes for ground truth, preventing watermark loop from crediting freed bytes incorrectly
Lock file .ticket-write.lock must never be shared between entries via hardlink because fcntl.flock is inode-scoped and would cause invisible cross-entry deadlock
